question: What proof binds an anonymous pilot applicant to an organization, which office may attest that binding, and what access, if any, may an applicant-typed organization claim give the stewards of that organization before the binding exists?
decision: An applicant-supplied organization identifier grants no access. Before binding an application, platform staff independently verifies a named organizational officer through an established institutional channel and records the method; domain verification is supporting evidence, not sufficient by itself. No steward or peer-organization read until binding is approved and audited. Sensitive attachments remain restricted even after binding.
originalProposedDecision: The applicant-typed org id grants nothing. Binding needs proof: an email at the org's verified domain or a letter from an officer, attested by a platform staff member. Until bound, no steward of any org sees the application.
